snippet.title: IShowSpeed Saw His Last Name in GTA 6, Then Called His Dad #GTA6
snippet.description:
OUR TAKE: Rockstar never said it's a nod to him. Speed's family has a story about that name anyway.

Watching GTA 6 Trailer 2 live, IShowSpeed (real name Darren Watkins) spots a 'Watkins Auto Parts' sign and loses it: he's in the game. Then he calls his dad on stream, and his dad tells chat the family story: Speed's great-grandfather opened Watkins Auto Parts after the Korean War. No leaks, no spoilers: just Speed reacting to the official Trailer 2.

Source: Live Speedy, "iShowSpeed Reacts To Grand Theft Auto VI Trailer 2": https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E07OTlhncP0
